生成された動画：=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

ADULT RIVEN:

Use the provided Adult Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, eye color, adult body proportions, and overall recognizable identity.

This is Adult Riven before joining the army.

She has grown up in this village and has spent many years practicing swordsmanship under her Father's guidance.

She is physically capable, disciplined, determined, and confident with a sword.

However, she has no real military or battlefield experience yet.

She should NOT behave like an inexperienced beginner.

She already understands stance, balance, grip, footwork, and basic sword control.

Her movements are practiced and controlled.

She is not flashy.

She does not perform acrobatics.

She does not possess supernatural abilities.

She is still wearing practical rural village clothing appropriate for training at home.

Do NOT give her military armor.

Do NOT make her look like an active soldier yet.


RIVEN'S FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve his exact facial identity, facial structure, hair, beard, body proportions, clothing, and overall silhouette.

He is the same former warrior who raised and trained Riven.

He no longer needs to physically correct her stance or grip.

At this point, he mainly watches.

Their years of training together should be communicated through familiarity.

He does not need long instructions.

One word is enough for Riven to understand him.


=== DIALOGUE LOCK — STRICT ===

There is only ONE spoken word in the entire video.

The Father speaks directly to Riven in natural ENGLISH:

"Again."

This is the ONLY dialogue.

Riven does not speak.

The soldiers do not speak.

The villagers do not speak.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No background conversations.

No Chinese or Mandarin speech.

No Vietnamese speech.

No non-English speech.

Do not add any other dialogue.


=== WEAPON LOCK — STRICT ===

Use the provided Old Sword reference image as the strict weapon reference.

Preserve the exact blade shape, proportions, crossguard, worn leather grip, pommel, materials, and weathered condition.

This is the same old sword belonging to Riven's Father.

Adult Riven has used this weapon for years and can now handle its weight naturally.

The weapon must still feel physical and heavy.

Her control comes from years of practice, not supernatural strength.

The sword remains old, practical, worn, and completely non-magical.

No glow.

No runes.

No energy.

No supernatural effects.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK — STRICT ===

Use the provided Riven Village / Home reference image as the strict environment reference.

The scene takes place beside the same family cottage in the familiar dirt-and-grass training area.

Preserve:

the cottage,
old tree,
chopping area,
stacked firewood,
dirt ground,
grass,
village road,
distant homes,
valley,
mountains.

The location should feel familiar and peaceful.

Soft natural daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Ordinary rural village life.

A road through the village must be naturally visible from the training area.

Later, a small military group passes along this road.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

Feature-film quality.

Grounded medieval fantasy.

Natural adult anatomy.

Realistic sword weight and momentum.

Realistic footwork.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Patient cinematic pacing.

Use only a few deliberate compositions.

Do not create a rapid training montage.

Do not show younger versions of Riven.

Do not morph Riven between ages.

Adult Riven remains visually identical throughout this entire video.

Do not change costumes.

Do not change locations.

Do not show multiple days.

The entire scene occurs during one continuous training session.

No flashy combat choreography.

No spinning attacks.

No acrobatics.

No supernatural speed.

No magical abilities.

No dramatic battle music.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Audio should remain natural:

wind,
birds,
village ambience,
boots against dirt,
sword cutting through air,
Riven's controlled breathing,
later distant horse hooves and subtle military equipment sounds.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Adult Riven is already training with her Father's old sword in the dirt-and-grass area beside their cottage.

She has clearly practiced for many years.

Her movements are confident, efficient, and controlled.

She performs a short practical sword sequence.

The choreography must remain grounded.

During one more difficult movement, Riven makes a small technical mistake.

She does NOT fall.

She immediately recognizes the mistake and stops.

Her Father is nearby watching.

He calmly says:

"Again."

Riven understands immediately.

She resets her stance.

She prepares to repeat the movement.

Before she begins, distant horse hooves become audible from the village road.

Riven pauses.

A small disciplined group of soldiers is passing through the village.

Riven watches them.

They are not threatening the village.

They are not villains.

They are simply professional soldiers traveling through.

From Riven's perspective, they represent something beyond the life she has always known.

Riven watches their discipline, armor, weapons, and movement.

Then she looks down at the old sword in her own hand.

Then back toward the soldiers.

Her Father notices this.

Instead of watching the soldiers, he watches Riven.

He understands what has caught her attention.

Neither character speaks.

End quietly.


=== SHOTS ===

Shot 1 — YEARS LATER

Begin extremely close on two adult hands gripping the familiar worn leather handle of the Father's old sword.

Do not show a child.

These are Adult Riven's hands.

The sword moves smoothly out of frame.

Reveal Adult Riven training in the familiar dirt-and-grass area beside the cottage.

The environment clearly establishes that this is the same home where she grew up.

Riven performs a short sequence of practical sword movements.

Her stance is stable.

Her footwork is controlled.

Her grip is confident.

The sword has real weight, but she now understands how to move with that weight.

She performs a controlled diagonal cut.

Recovers.

Changes her footing.

Performs another practical movement.

Do not make this a flashy combo.

The purpose is to show years of practice through control.

Riven attempts a slightly more difficult transition.

Her foot lands slightly wrong.

Her balance shifts subtly.

She immediately recognizes it.

She stops herself before completing the movement.

She remains standing.

Riven looks dissatisfied with the mistake.

Her Father is nearby watching.

He calmly says directly to her in English:

"Again."

Riven looks toward him.

No embarrassment.

No argument.

She understands.

She gives a subtle acknowledgment.

She resets her feet.

Raises the sword.

Prepares to repeat the movement.

Do not have her begin yet.

A distant sound interrupts the quiet:

horse hooves.

Riven pauses.

CUT.


Shot 2 — THE SOLDIERS

Riven lowers the sword slightly.

She turns her attention toward the village road.

The Father also notices the sound but remains calm.

Reveal a small disciplined military group traveling through the village.

Some soldiers walk.

Some may travel on horseback.

Their armor is practical and worn.

Their weapons are real military weapons.

Their formation is organized without looking ceremonial.

They are simply passing through.

They do not threaten villagers.

They do not interact aggressively with anyone.

Do not portray them as sinister.

Do not use ominous imagery.

Ordinary village life continues around them.

Riven watches silently.

Her attention is immediately captured by them.

Show what interests her:

disciplined movement,
controlled posture,
real weapons,
worn armor,
people who clearly belong to a world beyond this small village.

Return to Riven.

She has forgotten about repeating the training movement.

The old sword remains lowered in her hand.

She keeps watching.

CUT.


Shot 3 — BEYOND HOME

Use a quiet cinematic composition with Riven in the foreground.

The soldiers continue along the road farther into the distance.

Riven's eyes follow them.

Briefly show one soldier carrying a sword naturally at their side.

Return to Riven.

Her gaze slowly moves downward.

She looks at the old worn sword in her own hand.

Hold.

Then Riven looks back toward the departing soldiers.

Do not make her smile broadly.

Do not make her suddenly excited.

Her expression should communicate quiet realization and fascination.

For the first time, the wider world feels reachable.

Shift attention toward her Father.

He is not watching the soldiers anymore.

He is watching Riven.

He notices exactly how she is looking at them.

Riven does not notice her Father's gaze.

The soldiers continue farther away.

Riven remains standing in the training area with the old sword in her hand.

Gentle wind moves her pale-blonde hair.

No dialogue.

Hold the silence.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Adult Riven stands outside her family cottage holding her Father's old sword.

Her training has stopped.

A small group of soldiers is traveling away along the village road.

Riven watches them silently.

She has seen disciplined professional soldiers and has become deeply interested in the world they represent.

She has not announced any decision.

She has not joined them.

She does not follow them.

Her Father stands nearby watching Riven.

He understands her interest before she says anything.

Neither character speaks.

The soldiers continue away.

End with Riven holding the old sword and looking beyond the village.


=== MOOD ===

Grounded.

Warm.

Quietly ambitious.

Reflective.

This scene should communicate the passage of many years without showing an age transformation.

Adult Riven's skill is the evidence that time has passed.

The emotional progression is simple:

Adult Riven trains
→ makes one small mistake
→ Father says "Again."
→ Riven prepares to repeat
→ soldiers pass through the village
→ Riven becomes fascinated
→ she looks at their weapons
→ she looks at her Father's old sword
→ she looks back toward the soldiers
→ Father notices.

Do not add another story event.

Do not have Riven speak.

Do not have Riven join the soldiers.

Do not have the Father question her.

Do not turn the soldiers into villains.

Do not end with action.

End with the possibility of a life beyond the village entering Riven's mind for the first time.、16:9
